tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description:
Create a private two-hour workspace and return its ID and CAD upload page.

            Start here before loading a sample or importing a user's CAD part.
            The ID and upload/download links grant access; do not publish them.

tools.name: list_uploads
tools.description: List files uploaded through this workspace's upload_url; pass an upload_id to import_part.

tools.name: compare_drapes
tools.description:

tools.description: Export a built-in example as DXF or tiled 1:1 PDF and return a temporary download_url. tools.name: get_job
tools.description:
Poll STEP import or multi-piece layout; retry after a short delay while done=false.

        STEP completion returns a step_id and at most 20 basic face descriptions;
        use list_faces for geometric descriptions and pagination. Layout completion

tools.name: import_part
tools.description: Import a file already uploaded to this workspace. Get upload_id from list_uploads. STEP/STP returns a job to poll with get_job(kind='step'), then inspect and select faces.

tools.name: list_fabrics
tools.description: List fabric IDs, nominal locking angles, tow pitch (mm), thickness and UD settings.

tools.name: list_faces
tools.description:
Inspect STEP face IDs, areas, bounds, centroids, neighbours and planar mesh normals.

        This requires the MCP face-metadata endpoint in the configured backend.
        Centroids/bounds describe the tessellation; do not assume a closed solid's
        entire skin is the intended draping surface

tools.name: list_samples
tools.description: List built-in example parts that can be loaded without uploading a file.

tools.name: load_sample
tools.description: Register a built-in sample and return a mesh_id for draping.

tools.name: mesh_landmarks
tools.description:
Inspect seed landmarks in mm, paged within each category (max 100 per category).

        Returns centre, corners, edge midpoints and origin intersections. Full
        section polylines are omitted. Follow next_offset for more points.

tools.name: run_drape
tools.description:
Drape one fabric at one warp angle (degrees); return statistics and an exportable result_id.

tools.name: select_faces
tools.description: Create a drapable mesh from explicitly chosen STEP face IDs; reports connectedness.

tools.name: server_status
tools.description: Check the hosted DrapeCut solver and read connection/workspace limits.

tools.name: suggest_seed
tools.description: Suggest a starting point on a mesh. Validate its coverage with an actual drape.
